summary: First full test pass of Groove Sesh (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed (auth, sessions, tracks upload/download/patch/delete, audio streaming with token, user isolation, soft deletes). Frontend: Found and FIXED 2 crash bugs (Element type is invalid on /session/[id] and /paywall) caused by wrong phosphor-react-native imports. After fixes, login/signup, home Flying-V neck (JAM NOW + 5 frets), My Sessions, Import, Settings, Session (empty state with '0/4 tracks · Go Pro'), Paywall (Monthly $9.99 / Yearly $79.99 offerings loaded from RevenueCat Test Store), and JAM NOW record screen all render correctly on mobile viewport (390x844). Not fully validated in automation: actual mic recording, native file-picker import, RevenueCat purchase completion, clip editor gating with a real track.

minor.issue: Returns 200 even when session belongs to another user (matched_count is 0 but response is {ok:true}). No data leak because update only matches on user_id, but response is misleading. Consider returning 404 when matched_count == 0.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — Imported 'MetronomeSimple' from phosphor-react-native which does not exist (only 'Metronome' does). Caused ErrorBoundary crash 'Element type is invalid' on every session screen. Changed to 'Metronome' at import line 10 and JSX line 281.

FIXED — Imported '{ Infinity as InfinityIcon }' from phosphor-react-native; the actual export name is 'InfinityIcon' (JS globals 'Infinity' shadows the icon so the export is renamed in the package). Caused crash on /paywall. Changed import to '{ ..., InfinityIcon, ... }'.

issues: Fret buttons (58px) meet 44px touch target; Ok.
Layout renders cleanly; Monthly/Yearly cards visible.

react_native_issues.issue: phosphor-react-native named-import mismatch (Infinity aliased incorrectly; must import InfinityIcon directly). Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:6
Console warns 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow/textShadow). Widespread across ui.tsx / index.tsx / login.tsx. Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.80+.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from an internal component or 3rd-party lib. Non-blocking.

action_items: Validate the two import fixes locally (session screen and paywall) — main agent may prefer keeping the alias 'Infinity as InfinityIcon' but must import 'InfinityIcon' from the package (it's already renamed there).
Manually verify the multitrack Session screen with a recorded track (upload flow via UI). Automated mic recording is unreliable in headless Chromium.
Do a device / real-browser test of a RevenueCat sandbox purchase. Offerings render OK; a successful purchase couldn't be validated in headless.
Consider returning 404 from DELETE /api/sessions/{id} when the session does not belong to the requesting user (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: Free-tier check for tracks is client-only (per design). Consider a soft server hint if you ever add stricter enforcement.
Audio route accepts token via query string — fine for <audio> tags, but consider rate-limiting & short-lived signed URLs for production.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown (works in current pinned version, migrate to lifespan handlers eventually).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core flows verified; native file-picker/mic/RC purchase not fully automatable)

seed_data_creation: Test users created dynamically with TEST_ prefix via /api/auth/register. Sample WAV blobs generated in-memory for upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (21 tests, all pass against public URL). Two crash-inducing phosphor imports were fixed by the testing agent. If more phosphor icons are added later, sanity-check them against /app/frontend/node_modules/phosphor-react-native/src/icons/ — several icon names are non-obvious (Infinity => InfinityIcon export, Metronome (no 'Simple' variant), etc.). RevenueCat Test Store returns Monthly $9.99 / Yearly $79.99 offerings on preview URL.
rca_of_issue: Session screen and paywall both crashed with 'Element type is invalid: expected a string ... but got: undefined' inside React reconciler because phosphor-react-native does not export a symbol named 'MetronomeSimple' (only 'Metronome'), and its Infinity icon is exported under the name 'InfinityIcon' (the source uses '{ I as InfinityIcon }'). Importing the missing/misnamed symbol yields undefined, and React throws when that undefined is used as a JSX component tag. Fix: (1) session/[id].tsx: rename MetronomeSimple → Metronome (import + JSX). (2) paywall.tsx: import InfinityIcon directly instead of `Infinity as InfinityIcon`. Verified by reloading /session/{id} (shows empty tracks state, transport bar, metronome pill) and /paywall (shows Pro screen with packages) — no ErrorBoundary.
